title: commodity-basic-description — select species

filesToTouch.what: Add `export const commodityBasicDescriptionPage = { id: 'commodity-basic-description', slug: 'commodity-basic-description' }` to the group's import-free page.js (create the file with this export if pp-022/pp-023 have not yet created it). No imports — page.js must stay import-free (controller-flow cycle guard).

Controller transposing the live-animals nested-loop exemplar (sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/animal-identification/animal-identification.controller.js). `export const meta = { ...commodityBasicDescriptionPage, collects: [] }` — the commodityLines root is owned by commodity-search (pp-023); species group + members inherit dispatch coverage from the nearest ancestor group (the pp-012-characterised inheritance). ONE page renders a species card per commodity line (exemplar layout — NOT legacy's per-commodity re-entry; decision recorded in notes). GET: `state.get()` ONCE; lines via `state.collectionView(answers, ['commodityLines'])`; per line i, added species via `state.collectionView(answers, ['commodityLines', i, 'species'])`; filter state from query (`line`, `genus`, `eppoCode` — GET form per card carries a hidden `line` input); candidate list = pp-014 `speciesFor(line.commoditySelection)` MINUS already-added eppoCodes for that line, filtered case-insensitive-substring on genusAndSpecies AND eppoCode (each applied only when provided). POST branches on the submit button value: (a) `action === 'add:<lineIndex>:<eppoCode>'` — guard `Number.isInteger(lineIndex) && lineIndex >= 0 && lineIndex < lines.length` BEFORE any write (phantom-instance guard), refuse an eppoCode not in that line's fixture species list or already added (stale/forged form ⇒ no write), then `state.appendEntryAt(request, h, ['commodityLines', lineIndex, 'species'], { eppoCode, genusAndSpecies, speciesId })` — genusAndSpecies + speciesId DERIVED server-side from the pp-014 fixture by eppoCode, never read from the client; (b) `action === 'remove:<lineIndex>:<speciesIndex>'` — validate BOTH indices and that the entry exists, then `state.removeEntryAt(...)`; Remove available for EVERY added row including the last (do not copy legacy's 2+-only remove — model floor bites at continue, not at remove); (c) Continue — every line must hold >= 1 species, else 400 re-render with GDS 'There is a problem' summary + per-line error 'Select at least one Genus (and Species)' linking `#species-<lineIndex>`; valid Continue commits nothing and exits via `kit.hubExitTarget(request)` first then `await kit.nextTarget(request, page, committed.scope)`. All writes wrapped in `kit.recoverableSave()` (marked failure ⇒ recoverableError re-render 500; other errors throw); all internal add/remove/filter redirects wrapped in `kit.withChangeContext(request, href)`. `export const routes = kit.pageRoutes(page, { get, post })` — kit builds the route table from the PREFIX-FREE route-shape builder `pageRoutePath(slug)` at module load; the plant plugin's `/plant-products` mount prefix supplies the rest. Every rendered href/redirect/form action in this controller (self-redirect after add/remove, `kit.hubExitTarget`, `kit.nextTarget`) must come from the PREFIX-BEARING link builders (`pagePath`, `hubPath`) evaluated per request, so the emitted URLs carry `/plant-products`.

Vitest unit tests: GET renders one card per seeded line with commodity echo + added-species table + candidate list; candidate list excludes already-added eppoCodes; filter narrows (substring, case-insensitive, per provided field) and nil-match yields the noResults view state; add appends exactly {eppoCode, genusAndSpecies, speciesId} at ['commodityLines', i, 'species'] with fixture-derived values; add refuses non-integer / negative / out-of-range lineIndex, unknown eppoCode, duplicate eppoCode (no write in each case); remove deletes the addressed entry and refuses forged indices; remove works on the last remaining species; Continue with a zero-species line ⇒ 400, raw state preserved, error keyed to that line; Continue with all lines >= 1 species ⇒ redirect via nextTarget; recoverable save failure ⇒ 500 with recoverableError; unexpected errors throw.

Template extending 'shared/layout.njk' (unprefixed), view name under the plant TEMPLATES prefix. Caption 'Description of the goods' + H1 'Commodity'. Per line card: (1) commodity echo govuk-table (Commodity code / Description, visually-hidden caption); (2) added-species govuk-table (Genus (and Species) / EPPO code / visually-hidden 'Remove' action column) rendered only when the line has >= 1 species, per-row Remove as a POST submit button `name="action" value="remove:<lineIndex>:<speciesIndex>"` styled govuk-button govuk-button--secondary; (3) fieldset legend--m 'Select Genus (and Species) of commodity' (NO trailing space — legacy defect not copied) + hint 'You can add multiple Genus (and Species)'; (4) filter as a GET form — govuk-input 'Genus (and Species)', govuk-input 'EPPO code', govuk-button 'Search', govuk-link 'Clear', hidden `line` input — plain govuk-fieldset in a grid row with govuk-!-* spacing utilities, NO bespoke .search-panel CSS; (5) results govuk-table (Genus (and Species) / EPPO code / visually-hidden 'Add' action column) with per-row Add as a POST submit button `name="action" value="add:<lineIndex>:<eppoCode>"` styled govuk-button--secondary — FIXED control name carrying the data as its VALUE, never data-derived names/ids (add-species-<id> anti-pattern banned); empty result set renders 'No search results' as one full-width cell inside the results table with the header row kept (empty state, NOT an error). NO pagination (fixture lists are small; decision recorded). NO conditional Cancel link (legacy quirk not copied). Shared error summary + save actions; input name = id = error key so `#species-<lineIndex>` anchors focus.

acceptanceCriteria: With PLANT_PRODUCTS_MODE=stub (records stub only — there is no set selector; live-animals is co-resident in the same process and unaffected), with at least one commodity line present, /plant-products/notifications/{journeyId}/commodity-basic-description renders caption 'Description of the goods', H1 'Commodity', and one species card per commodity line (commodity code + fixture-derived description echo).

The per-line filter is a pure server GET round trip (zero client XHR): filtering by a fixture EPPO code narrows that line's results to the match; a filter matching nothing renders 'No search results' as a single full-width cell inside the results table with the header row retained and NO govuk-error-summary (empty state, not an error).

Per-row Add is a POST submit button with the FIXED name 'action' and value 'add:<lineIndex>:<eppoCode>' (govuk-button--secondary); a successful Add persists exactly { eppoCode, genusAndSpecies, speciesId } at answers.commodityLines[lineIndex].species[], with genusAndSpecies and speciesId derived server-side from the pp-014 fixture, and the species appears in that line's added-species table and survives reload.

Already-added species are excluded from that line's candidate results (anti-duplicate); an Add for a duplicate or fixture-unknown eppoCode, or a non-integer/negative/out-of-range line index, performs NO write (stale/forged form guard at two levels before touching the store).

Per-row Remove (POST-only, action value 'remove:<lineIndex>:<speciesIndex>') deletes the addressed species and works for EVERY row including the last remaining species; forged indices are refused with no write.

Save and continue while ANY commodity line has zero species re-renders 400 with the GDS 'There is a problem' summary and 'Select at least one Genus (and Species)' (SPECIES_CHEDPP copy ruling) linking to and focusing the offending line's species fieldset, all raw state preserved; with every line holding >= 1 species it advances via kit.nextTarget (variety-of-genus-and-species when in scope once pp-025 lands, else next in section), hub exit winning first.
The hub commodities row (existing row — no new task row) shows In progress while a line's species floor is unmet; no hub copy or GROUPS change.

Exemplars (transpose, don't invent): sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/animal-identification/animal-identification.controller.js (+ records/append.js, remove/post-remove.js, card/view-model.js) — the proven depth-2 nested-loop surface (collects: [], per-line cards, appendEntryAt/removeEntryAt with parent-index guards); search/search.controller.js for the collects-root contrast; src/server/app/contract.test.js:251-275 for the depth-2 contract case shape. Model + bindings + mapper for the species subtree land with pp-021 (obligations/sections/commodities/species.js, grouped bindings with groups [commodityLines, species] in the commodities feature evaluation.js, records-mapper round trip) — this increment builds the collecting PAGE only and must verify, not re-add, those; the depth ground is proven by pp-012 (P-7 characterisation, a hard prerequisite). Decisions (headless, recorded): (1) single-page all-lines card layout per the animal-identification exemplar instead of legacy's per-commodity re-entry — same captured data, house URL scheme unchanged (shared/paths.js has no per-line segment), and pp-025 extends the same surface to depth 3; (2) error copy is the CHED-PP-specific 'Select at least one Genus (and Species)' (SPECIES_CHEDPP) per the page spec's explicit rebuild ruling, not the generic string legacy actually renders; (3) legacy anti-patterns NOT copied, per the page spec's govukAlternative rulings: data-derived control names (add-species-<id>, #<EPPO>-checkbox) replaced by fixed action-name/value submits; link-button replaced by govuk-button--secondary; hand-rolled next-only pagination dropped entirely (fixture lists are small); .search-panel/.table-responsive/.text-align-right bespoke CSS replaced by govuk grid + utilities; (4) Remove always available including the last species (legacy only rendered Remove at 2+ — recorded gap; the model floor enforces at continue); (5) conditional Cancel link (rendered only pre-add) not copied — spec advises against; (6) filter semantics decided as case-insensitive substring per provided field, AND-combined (legacy semantics live in an unseen reference-data service); (7) already-added species excluded from results, matching the trace-inferred anti-duplicate rule; (8) NO species/commodity-line cap declared — legacy's MAX_COMMODITY_LINES is config-sourced with unknown value and SIBLING-SET-PLAN §3.3 declares no cap surface for species (policy.maxEntriesFrom = {}); requires.maxEntries is additive later. The machinery-checkbox and hidden-block renderings are RECORDED (docs/README.md deviation log), not built — every pp-014 fixture code is a plant code. dependsOn excludes pp-023 (parallel per the source graph) but the serial build loop lands pp-023 first; the e2e spec creates its commodity line through commodity-search — if this increment ever runs before pp-023, seed the line via the stub records service in the spec's setup and note it. Both pp-023 and pp-024 edit flow.js/task-rows.js/page.js/copy — serial execution avoids the same-file conflict.
openQuestions: Species/commodity-line cap: legacy caps commodity lines per notification at a config-driven N (MAX_COMMODITY_LINES, value unknowable from the corpus) with three different message variants; pass 1 declares NO cap (per SIBLING-SET-PLAN §3.3). Needs a product ruling on whether a cap returns and at what N (additive via requires.maxEntries).

Machinery/checkbox rendering trigger: legacy renders species as checkboxes for machinery codes via the SHARED non-chedpp template — whether that routing is commodity-code-driven or reference-data-flag-driven is an unresolved legacy discrepancy; becomes real work only when non-plant codes enter the pp-014 fixture.

Hidden-block rendering (commodity with NO species reference data skips the whole selection block): recorded, unbuilt — with the model's species minEntries 1 floor such a commodity could never complete; needs a ruling whether the floor should be conditional on species data existing before any no-species commodity is added to the fixture.

Filter match semantics (substring vs prefix, AND-vs-OR inside the reference query) were unverifiable in legacy (logic lives in the unseen reference-data service); decided here as case-insensitive substring AND — flag to design if type-ahead/autocomplete is preferred later (the page spec's own preferred alternative).
